summary: First-order Python probe of parked open questions Q1+Q2 (0255 named list) against the terminal face hOffCPT2. Closed forms only (3-term EM legs + Mval masses + pinned devProg straddle map from the 0252 engine); no zeta evaluation, no zero-set data, no RH claim. Measured on the full band grid (t 1e3..1e20 x d0 1/200..0.3733819666133, 108 points): (1) the S1 fill-leg threshold C*1 (R1 = 1, decreasing in the decoupled fill run Coff) and the S4 wire-leg threshold C*4 (R4 = 1, increasing in the decoupled wire run Con) are the SAME function: C*1 == C*4 == C*(d0) ~= 1/(8 d0^2), t-independent to O(t^-2), measured to relative 3.5e-9 worst (finite dev-grid at small t) and 1e-25 (dps-60 machine) at large t. (2) The decoupled joint (R1 > 1 and R4 > 1 simultaneously) closes on 108/108 band points via the direct construction Coff = C*/2 < C* < 2C* = Con with measured margin ratio min(R1, R4) = 2.0000 at every point (knife-edge asymptotic, t- and d0-independent). (3) This is exactly the 2026-10-16 in-tree rejection, now quantified: with decoupled runs the legs bound DIFFERENT quantities (a fill truncated at run n_off vs a wire truncated at run n_on), so no single shared Qside value is squeezed - decoupling alone is NOT a route; the shared-value constraint is the obstruction. (4) Tail-transfer scale at (tPT2, 1/200): the runs differ (n_off/n_on = 3.792 even at C = C*), the T1 terms are identically (1/2C) t^-2 (knife-edge normalization; dps-60 roundoff between evaluation paths 2.16e-25 relative), and the higher EM terms + mass triangle scale is cert/devProg = 3.1198e-46 (d23_off = 7.23e-76, d23_on = 2.74e-75, |dMval| = 6.78e-84, devProg = 1.1110e-29). VERDICT: nothing at the SCALE level blocks a tail-transfer certificate; the Q2 route is a FORMAL work item - a re-typed single-shared-value S3 statement (S1 certified at fill run n_off, S4/S3 wire at wire run n_on, the same shared fill bounded by both via a term-level certificate in body) plus the per-pin data at the decoupled runs (the 2026-10-16 note items (i)+(ii) named in 0255). Decoupled run-decoupling (Q1) is closed sharpened: trivially satisfiable at the closed-form leg level, void at the shared-value level. No RH claim.
